desktop.overview: Compact account identity above grouped destinations with current-value summaries.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Canonical action with hover, focus and press states.
components.css: .ds-button-primary{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text,#f5f5f7);border:0;cursor:pointer;min-height:44px;padding:11px 20px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;border-radius:10px;transition:background 150ms ease-out,scale 150ms ease-out;background:var(--text,#f5f5f7);color:#161618;}.ds-button-primary:hover{background:#fff;}.ds-button-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#a8caff);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-button-primary:active{scale:.98;}.ds-button-primary:disabled{opacity:.42;cursor:default;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-primary{transition-duration:.01ms;}}

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Canonical action with hover, focus and press states.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text,#f5f5f7);border:0;cursor:pointer;min-height:44px;padding:11px 20px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;border-radius:10px;transition:background 150ms ease-out,scale 150ms ease-out;background:#ffffff12;color:var(--text,#f5f5f7);}.ds-button-secondary:hover{background:#ffffff20;}.ds-button-secondary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#a8caff);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-button-secondary:active{scale:.98;}.ds-button-secondary:disabled{opacity:.42;cursor:default;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-secondary{transition-duration:.01ms;}}

components.name: Icon button
components.description: A compact control with a 44px target.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon" aria-label="Close"><svg width="21" height="21" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m18 6-12 12M6 6l12 12"/></svg></button>

components.name: Labeled field
components.description: Dark inset field with a persistent label.
components.css: .ds-field{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:550;color:var(--text,#f5f5f7);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;}.ds-field input{font:inherit;background:#141416;color:var(--text,#f5f5f7);border:1px solid #ffffff26;border-radius:9px;min-height:44px;padding:10px 12px;min-width:0;caret-color:var(--accent,#a8caff);}.ds-field input::placeholder{color:#9b9ba4;}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#a8caff);outline-offset:4px;}@media(prefers-contrast:more){.ds-field input{border-color:#aaa;}}

components.name: Destination navigation
components.description: Segmented desktop destination states; the app relocates this row on mobile.
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:5px;align-items:center;}.ds-nav button{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text,#f5f5f7);border:0;cursor:pointer;font-size:15px;padding:10px 22px;min-height:44px;color:var(--secondary,#b1b1b8);border-radius:9px;background:none;}.ds-nav button:hover{color:var(--text,#f5f5f7);}.ds-nav button[aria-current]{color:var(--text,#f5f5f7);background:#ffffff12;}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#a8caff);outline-offset:4px;}@media(max-width:640px){.ds-nav button{font-size:14px;padding:10px;}}

components.name: Season selector
components.description: Selectable season state with a quiet translucent fill.
components.css: .ds-seasons{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;}.ds-seasons button{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:15px;border:0;cursor:pointer;padding:12px 20px;border-radius:8px;color:var(--secondary,#b1b1b8);background:#ffffff08;white-space:nowrap;}.ds-seasons button[aria-selected="true"]{color:var(--text,#f5f5f7);background:#ffffff20;}.ds-seasons button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#a8caff);outline-offset:4px;}@media(max-width:640px){.ds-seasons button{font-size:14px;}}

components.name: Poster card
components.description: The shipped missing-artwork state demonstrates structure without fixture artwork.
components.css: .ds-card{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "Segoe UI", sans-serif;display:block;width:180px;min-width:0;text-align:left;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:12px;background:none;color:var(--text,#f5f5f7);cursor:pointer;}.ds-poster{display:block;aspect-ratio:2/3;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface,#1c1c1f);transition:transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),box-shadow 220ms ease-out;}.ds-fallback{height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:12px;text-align:center;padding:15px;color:var(--secondary,#b1b1b8);background:#24242a;}.ds-fallback>span:first-child{font-size:12px;}.ds-card-title{display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden;font-size:14px;font-weight:550;line-height:1.4;margin-top:12px;}.ds-card-meta{display:block;color:var(--secondary,#b1b1b8);font-size:12px;margin-top:4px;}.ds-card:hover .ds-poster{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 10px 25px #0005;}.ds-card:active .ds-poster{transform:scale(.98);}.ds-card:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#a8caff);outline-offset:4px;}@media(max-width:640px){.ds-card-title{font-size:13px;}.ds-card:hover .ds-poster{transform:none;box-shadow:none;}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-poster{transition-duration:.01ms;}.ds-card:hover .ds-poster{transform:none;}}

narrative.overview:
Apple TV is the confirmed visual reference: restrained dark neutrals, system sans typography and white primary actions. Media supplies the imagery; the interface supplies stable organization, clear labels and precise playback controls. Modern Jellyfin utility informs the density and completeness of administration.

Depth comes from tonal surfaces and purposeful overlays. Motion responds to opening details, selecting media and revealing playback controls. Desktop and mobile browsers share the system; native TV clients are separate products.
keyCharacteristics: Media-first shelves and searchable poster grids.
Quiet neutral surfaces with white primary actions.
Readable utility controls and visible keyboard focus.

rules.name: The Focus Color Rule
rules.body: Keep blue tied to interaction and focus; primary actions use white.

rules.name: The Viewing Rule
rules.body: Controls recede only while uninterrupted playback can continue; interaction and recovery states remain legible.

dos: - **Do** let library artwork lead and reuse the neutral text fallback when it is unavailable.
- **Do** preserve visible focus, labeled fields, safe-area spacing and reduced-motion behavior.
- **Do** keep personal preferences visibly separate from administrator controls.
- **Do** retain useful media detail backdrops and readable overlays in their existing contexts.
donts: - **Don't** add promotional filler, random rotating billboards or decorative footer copy.
- **Don't** replace white primary actions with a decorative accent color.
- **Don't** turn synthetic review posters or video color bars into product artwork or palette tokens.
